sql='''-- Top two genres by 2021 revenue per billing country (read-only SQLite).
WITH period_lines AS (
    -- Filter invoices early; InvoiceDate is stored as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' text.
    SELECT
        inv.BillingCountry AS country,
        trk.GenreId AS genre_id,
        CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity AS line_cents,
        il.Quantity AS quantity
    FROM Invoice AS inv
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
        ON il.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS trk
        ON trk.TrackId = il.TrackId
    WHERE inv.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND inv.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
      AND inv.BillingCountry IS NOT NULL
),
country_genre AS (
    SELECT
        pl.country,
        pl.genre_id,
        gen.Name AS genre,
        SUM(pl.line_cents) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(pl.quantity) AS units
    FROM period_lines AS pl
    JOIN Genre AS gen
        ON gen.GenreId = pl.genre_id
    GROUP BY pl.country, pl.genre_id, gen.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cg.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cg.country
            ORDER BY cg.revenue_cents DESC, cg.genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM country_genre AS cg
)
SELECT
    country,
    genre_id,
    genre,
    revenue_cents,
    units,
    country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
'''
open('/work/query.sql','w').write(sql)
import sqlite3,collections
def run(conn):
    cur=conn.execute(open('/work/query.sql').read()); return [d[0] for d in cur.description],cur.fetchall()
c=sqlite3.connect('file:/inputs/Chinook.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)
cols,rows=run(c); print(cols,len(rows))
for r in rows[:8]: print(r, [type(x).__name__ for x in r])
def ref(conn):
    agg=collections.defaultdict(lambda:[0,0]);names=dict(conn.execute("select GenreId,Name from Genre"))
    for country,g,p,q in conn.execute("select i.BillingCountry,t.GenreId,il.UnitPrice,il.Quantity from Invoice i join InvoiceLine il using(InvoiceId) join Track t using(TrackId) where i.InvoiceDate>='2021-01-01' and i.InvoiceDate<'2022-01-01'"):
        if country is None or g not in names: continue
        a=agg[(country,g)];a[0]+=round(p*100)*q;a[1]+=q
    out=[];bc=collections.defaultdict(list)
    for (ct,g),(r,u) in agg.items(): bc[ct].append((-r,g,u))
    for ct in sorted(bc):
        for i,(nr,g,u) in enumerate(sorted(bc[ct])[:2],1): out.append((ct,g,names[g],-nr,u,i))
    return out
